meta.title: Find disabled parking spaces near your destination
meta.description: Search for an address or place to find known disabled parking spaces nearby. No account needed.

hero.eyebrow: For everyone with a disabled parking card
hero.title: Find disabled parking spaces near your destination
hero.intro: Search for an address or place. The map shows the disabled parking spaces NIPKaart knows about nearby.
hero.intro_short: Search an address or place and see which disabled parking spaces are nearby.
hero.label: Where are you going?

preview.alt: Example map around the Rijksmuseum with disabled parking spaces and a garage
preview.title: Example parking results

legend.title: How to read the map
legend.intro: Choose a marker to see the details.

space.title: Disabled parking space
space.text: From municipal data or added by a visitor. The details show any known times and rules.

garage.title: Garage or P+R
garage.text: When a current measurement is available, the number shows free spaces across the whole garage or site.

cluster.title: Several parking locations
cluster.text: Nearby parking locations share a marker. Zoom in to see them individually.

destination.title: Your destination
destination.text: Distances are measured from this point, so you can see which parking space is closest.

garages.title: Check occupancy at garages and park-and-ride sites
garages.text: When a current measurement is available, you can see how many spaces were free across the whole facility and when they were measured.
garages.text_short: See general occupancy where a current measurement is available.

contribute.title: Is a parking space missing?
contribute.text: Know a disabled parking space that is missing? Add it. If it is already on the map, open its details to confirm it is still there or report that it is gone.
contribute.step: Put the pin on the spot
contribute.next: Then fill in the orientation and any time limits
